channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tom Benson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tom Benson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: David Stern on Tom Benson
item.description:
“But if there was an ideal or perfect candidate to own it, it was Tom Benson. He was always our target. We were fortunate he warmed to the idea.”

David Stern on Tom Benson, Mar 24, 2018. Source: The Advocate.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Tom Benson
item.description:
#Pelicans guard Jrue Holiday on Tom Benson:

“He’s done so much for the city of New Orleans. He’s done so much for our organization and the Saints organization. We’ve just got to go out and play for him.”

Jrue Holiday on Tom Benson, Mar 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Mike Bass on Tom Benson, Gayle Benson
item.description:
Scott Kushner:NBA Spokesman Mike Bass’ said this on the #Pelicans ownership situation:

“As we mourn the loss of Tom Benson, we know the New Orleans Pelicans are on strong and stable footing as Gayle Benson,currently the team’s Alternate Governor, assumes control of the franchise.”

Mike Bass on Tom Benson, Gayle Benson, Mar 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @ScottDKushner.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Tom Benson
item.description:
Alvin Gentry on Tom Benson:

“The thing I remember most, after every win he comes down from the locker room and gets in the circle and puts his hand in and 1, 2,3 Pelicans or whatever. I think our guys really enjoy that, and knew that he cared so much about our team and everything we were trying to do. His goal was to try and bring a championship to New Orleans, same that he did for the Saints.”

Alvin Gentry on Tom Benson, Mar 15, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Tom Benson
item.description:
Pelicans coachAlvin Gentry on the death of Tom Benson:

“We lost a giant. The things that he's done, not just for the Pelicans and the Saints, but for the state of Louisiana. He's a self-made man that had the biggest heart you could ever imagine. In my case, as a coach of a team, you would only want the owner to do everything he can to possibly help you win a championship. I can say without a doubt Mr. B has done that.”

Alvin Gentry on Tom Benson, Mar 15, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tom Benson
item.description:
Gregg Popovich on the passing of Tom Benson:

“Over the years, we actually corresponded a couple of times. He was very kind to me on various occasions,and I would respond. He's been a very inclusive, fair-minded, just good person to everybody involved, whether you're with the New Orleans organization or not.”

Gregg Popovich on Tom Benson, Mar 15, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Tom Benson
item.description:
I reached Dallas Mavericks' ownerMark Cuban, on #Pelicans' owner Tom Benson's death:

“It’s a sad day for professional sports. Mr. Benson has always been an incredible advocate for his teams and the city of New Orleans.”

Mark Cuban on Tom Benson, Mar 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @ScottDKushner.
